top_signals.title: Yen Edges Toward 160 Despite Takaichi’s Support for BOJ Hike
top_signals.summary: The yen remains within striking distance of a crucial level against the dollar, even after Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s government was said to support an interest-rate hike.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: The Struggle to Build the TAPI Gas Pipeline Through Afghanistan
top_signals.summary: Amid a thicket of hopeful rhetoric surrounding the construction of a trans-Afghan pipeline that would carry natural gas from Turkmenistan to South Asia, tangible signs of progress are hard to find. The pipeline, known as TAPI (Turkmenistan-Afghanistan-Pakistan-India), has been on the drawing board for decades, and construction of the first leg of the route, a 153-kilometer stretch from the Turkmen border at Serhetabat to the western Afghan city of Herat, is by most accounts inching along.
